entities.name: Date of Tribute
entities.description: A recurring annual event in ancient Corondor in which offerings were made to Sol'Kanar under threat of destruction.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: The Swamp King of Corondor who demanded tribute and submerged the caravan path.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: Spellcaster of Khone sent into Sol'Kanar's service.

entities.name: Chondaeh
entities.description: Spellcaster of Shikar sent into Sol'Kanar's service.

entities.name: Kingdom of Khone
entities.description: A Corondor kingdom forced to pay tribute.

entities.name: Kingdom of Shikar
entities.description: A Corondor kingdom forced to pay tribute.

entities.name: Contrary Kingdoms
entities.description: Collective name for Khone and Shikar.

entities.name: Scarzam Dragon
entities.description: Last known dragon Sol'Kanar intended to summon.

entities.name: Dragon War
entities.description: Conflict precipitated by the tribute spellcasters.

entities.name: Sivitri's War
entities.description: War centuries before the tribute began.

events.summary: Sol'Kanar submerges the caravan path between Khone and Shikar and uses it as leverage to demand tribute.
events.quote: By deliberately submerging this critical trade artery beneath the waters of his swamp

events.summary: Khone and Shikar must send regular offerings under threat of destruction, and are called the Contrary Kingdoms.
events.quote: the two kingdoms were compelled to send regular offerings directly to him

events.summary: The tribute becomes one spellcaster per realm; Gydolien Mor and Chondaeh are sent into Sol'Kanar's service, precipitating the Dragon War.
events.quote: Their involvement directly precipitated the outbreak of the Dragon War
